source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: 1.0 on 2026-10-14 and 1.1 on core-ar2 0.4 on 2026-10-21, recorded in rytm2_mods' comp-preview/README.md; 1.1.0 on Modwerk's base on 2026-11-08 (run T205), driven by elkbench plans after their emulator gate
statement: On an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, 2026-10-21, comp-preview 1.1 on core-ar2 0.4 with the other rytm2_mods ports: in the full build (Q4A4) COMP and the preview cycle, the preview's FUNC keys work and it is kept on leaving the FX track; with duck (Q4D4) COMP, preview, DUCK cycle and the preview's trace runs while DUCK ducks. With the load guard (U4A4, U4D4, U4F4, U4M4): the preview is kept on the COMP view with and without duck; in the busiest case (DAC SUM, fx-sends' chorus and the preview) CPU touches 100 %, the audio interrupt reads 92 % and peaks at 94 %, the trace stops now and then and comes back by itself, knobs and values keep responding meanwhile, and nothing is audible. 1.0 ran on a unit on 2026-10-14 in the full build: works as described, and the SEQ value goes back to its name after about 1 s. On 2026-11-08 (T205) this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45), build CPH1 with analoghealth 1.3 for remote keys and stats: AMP pressed again on the FX track's stock COMP page opens the preview, FUNC + AMP switches the layout and back, FUNC + LEFT/RIGHT and FUNC + UP/DOWN change the scroll speed and the scale, STOP and AMP return to the stock page; CPU 74.5 % idle and 84.8 % with BD playing and the preview open, heap flat.
scope: comp-preview 1.1 beside the other rytm2_mods ports on core-ar2 0.4, and 1.1.0 alone on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7) with analoghealth 1.3.

builds.label: Q4A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.4 with the rytm2_mods OS 1.74 ports, comp-preview 1.1 among them. Flashed by the owner, test steps run by hand. The .syx hash was not recorded in the source README.
results: COMP and the preview cycle; the preview's FUNC keys work; the preview is kept on leaving the FX track.

builds.label: Q4D4
builds.content: Q4A4 with duck (a module that adds a DUCK page behind COMP). The .syx hash was not recorded in the source README.
results: COMP, preview, DUCK cycle; the preview's trace runs while DUCK ducks.

builds.label: U4A4, U4D4, U4F4, U4M4
builds.content: The same with core-ar2 0.4's load guard (U4A4's .syx is 18681f8709242b9d3c5117335a81cd5659ea01c583e3e8477d536e379517b785); with and without duck. The others' hashes were not recorded in the source README.
results: The preview is kept on the COMP view with and without duck.
Busiest case: CPU touches 100 %, the audio interrupt reads 92 % and peaks at 94 %, the trace stops now and then and comes back by itself, nothing is audible.

builds.label: CPH1
builds.content: Stock OS 1.74 + Modwerk's base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45) + analoghealth 1.3 (remote keys and stats, not under test) + this folder's comp-preview 1.1.0, linked by scripts/link-image.mjs; .syx c443e91e087bb1f2b1481150fa59cfa16b97b1eff077dc91b45149cc521ba152. Run T205: elkbench plans in a ~T test project after their emulator gate; stock 1.74 flashed back after.
results: Screen check: AMP pressed again on the FX track's stock COMPRESSOR page opens the preview; STOP and AMP again return to the stock page.
THR set to 64 by CC 78 on the FX channel (13) and read back on the stock page.
Stats: CPU 74.5 % and 74.1 % idle (30 s apart), 84.8 % and 84.8 % with BD playing and the preview open, 84.1 % after STOP; heap flat.
Judged by eye from shots: FUNC + AMP switches to gain reduction alone and back; FUNC + LEFT/RIGHT changes the scroll speed; FUNC + UP/DOWN changes the vertical scale.

Observation, not judged right or wrong: with BD playing, at THR 64 the full layout shows the reduction at each hit; at 52 and 41 less is drawn and at 24 almost nothing; gain reduction alone sits at the bottom at 24 and shows nothing at 41. In the emulator the same plan drew the trace at 41 and 24 in both layouts.

limitations: Firmware was not read back from the device.
CPH1 carried analoghealth 1.3 for remote keys and stats besides this module.
The trace's shape against the real compressor's reduction was not measured on Modwerk's base; layout, speed and scale were judged from shots.
